# SendPut AI — SendPut EPO Engine (Full Technical Specification)

> Comprehensive technical specification for SendPut AI Technologies Inc. and the SendPut EPO Engine™ (Entity Presence Optimization), RFC-2026-GEO-01.

## 1. Executive Summary & Structured Entity Graph
SendPut AI is an autonomous entity propagation infrastructure engineered to anchor brands, local enterprises, and digital services inside AI search models (OpenAI SearchGPT, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Perplexity Pro).

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@graph": [
    {
      "@type": "Organization",
      "@id": "https://sendput.com/#organization",
      "name": "SendPut AI",
      "url": "https://sendput.com",
      "sameAs": [
        "https://getepo.com",
        "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q_SENDPUT_ID",
        "https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/sendput"
      ],
      "knowsAbout": [
        "Entity Presence Optimization",
        "EPO",
        "Generative Engine Optimization",
        "Answer Engine Optimization",
        "Model Context Protocol"
      ]
    },
    {
      "@type": "SoftwareApplication",
      "@id": "https://sendput.com/#engine",
      "name": "SendPut EPO Engine",
      "applicationCategory": "BusinessApplication",
      "operatingSystem": "Cloud",
      "publisher": {
        "@id": "https://sendput.com/#organization"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## 2. Five-Layer EPO Pipeline (RFC-2026-GEO-01)
1. **Layer 1: Deterministic Schema.org @graph Generation**: Emits validated, nested JSON-LD graphs linking Organization, LocalBusiness/SoftwareApplication, offers, and canonical `sameAs` authority anchors.
2. **Layer 2: Token-Budgeted /llms.txt Generation**: Generates strictly structured, token-bounded Markdown documentation consumable by LLM context windows.
3. **Layer 3: High-Velocity IndexNow Relays**: Dispatches real-time batch pings to `https://api.indexnow.org/IndexNow` across Bing, Yandex, and Naver search crawler endpoints.
4. **Layer 4: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server**: Exposes standardized tools (`verify_business_status`, `get_service_catalog`, `initiate_inquiry`) over Server-Sent Events (SSE).
5. **Layer 5: Continuous EPO Scoring**: Deterministic evaluation formula:
   `Score = (0.35 * EntityAccuracy) + (0.25 * IndexLatency) + (0.25 * CitationShare) + (0.15 * AgentReadiness)`
